Tanker Struck by Projectile Near Strait of Hormuz, Two Crew Injured

A tanker was struck by an "unknown projectile" as it entered the Strait of Hormuz, resulting in injuries to two crew members. The incident occurred near the Strait of Hormuz, a key waterway for global oil transport. The attack on the tanker coincided with a fall in oil prices, with Brent crude approaching $100 per barrel.
